title: Analysis and display preferences
costHint: Weighted average changes only economic P/L. The tax view and lots always use FIFO.
analytical: Analytical view — weighted average. This is not the tax view.
taxHint: Changing the date or FX margin recalculates the tax view. Source transactions stay unchanged.
taxIncludeFxFee: Include the currency conversion margin in the tax cost
timezoneHint: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Exchange session dates do not change with the time zone.
sync: Preferences are saved to your account and available on other devices. Synchronization does not replace unsaved form edits.
invalid: Unable to save preferences. Check the field values, including the time zone name.
